fx.hook: THE LAST ONE IS THE WORST

scenes.vo: 22 of my saved reels wouldn't tell me anything unless I commented.

scenes.label: DROP THE ZIP IN
scenes.vo: So I dropped my saves into SaveSort.

scenes.label: TAP GATED GUIDES
scenes.vo: Tap gated guides, and there they all are. Let's open a few.

scenes.quote: Comment PHONE and I'll send the setup
scenes.vo: Comment phone? It connects Claude Code to an AI phone service, so it rings you. Free plan, then about 9 cents a minute.
Comment design? Three design skills for Claude. Free, and public anyway.

scenes.quote: Comment SCALE to grow your business
scenes.vo: Comment scale? No tip at all. Just a sales call waiting to happen.
Plot twist. Most of it was free all along. No comment needed.

scenes.heading: Before you comment
scenes.label: 30 SECOND CHECK
scenes.vo: Before you comment, check the caption, search the tool's name, see if it's free. Then decide.
Tap the link in bio and find your gated guides.
